decisions.statement: A command invoked from a terminal tab reaches the seat in that tab.
A tab is matched to a seat by the instance id ending the tab's uri path.
A uri of any other scheme names no seat.
A path whose last segment is no whole number names no seat.
A row is taken only where that row reads as a seat that is running or stopped.
A subagent row is no target for an act.
Nothing here acts on a seat.

definition: which seat a command was invoked on, whether from a row of the panel or from a tab
